artifactFamily: Orbo Pluto Zeitgeist Z0-Z30 canonical boundary table
yearNumbering: astronomical year numbering; year 0 = 1 BCE; negative year -3532 = 3533 BCE
numberingAnchor: Z0 begins at astronomical year -3532-05-24T02:38:40.271Z (May 24, 3533 BCE). This numbering is validated forward by exact agreement with Z22 in 1822 and Z23 in 2066.

laws.ownership: A Zeitgeist begins and takes ownership at Pluto's first direct ingress into Aries. Ownership transfers at the next Zeitgeist's first direct Aries ingress.
laws.shadow: If Pluto returns to Pisces after a new Zeitgeist begins, the previous Zeitgeist remains as Shadow until Pluto's final direct egress from Pisces into Aries.
laws.preShadow: Pre-shadow begins at Pluto's earlier direct crossing of the degree of the later direct station in Pisces to which Pluto falls back after the first Aries ingress.
